title: PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , HOUSING ELEMENT ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (EIR), STATE CLEARINGHOUSE (SCH) NO. 2021010130, HOUSING…
text:
[Council File 26-1355; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , HOUSING ELEMENT ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (EIR), STATE CLEARINGHOUSE (SCH) NO. 2021010130, HOUSING ELEMENT EIR, ADDENDUM NO. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1), ADDENDUM NO. 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), ADDENDUM NO. 4 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD4), AND RELATED EIR FINDINGS relative to the San Pedro Zoning Code Update.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. DETERMINE, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the San Pedro Zoning Code Update was analyzed in the Housing Element Environmental Impact Report (SCH No. 2021010130) (Housing Element EIR) certified on November 29, 2021, and Addendum No. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1), Addendum No. 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), Addendum No. 4 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD4); the San Pedro Zoning Code Update is within the scope of the project covered by the Housing Element EIR; and the Housing Element EIR adequately describes the activity for the purposes of CEQA; and pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15162, 15164 and 15168, no subsequent or supplemental environmental impact report is required.
2. ADOPT the FINDINGS of the Los Angeles City Planning Commission (LACPC) as the Findings of Council. (Identified as "Exhibit A – Staff Recommendation Report and Technical Modifications, and Exhibit B - City Charter, LAMC, and General Plan Findings dated June 11, 2026, attached to the Council file.)
3. INSTRUCT the Director of Planning to amend the Environmental Protection Measures pursuant to Division 4C.13. (Environmental Protection) of the New Zoning Code, as appropriate to incorporate the mitigation measures in the Mitigation Monitoring Program, and adopt water resource standards to prevent damage or disturbance to water resources, ensuring consistency with California Fish and Wildlife Code Section 1602.
4. INSTRUCT the Department of City Planning (DCP) to finalize the necessary General Plan land use designation maps, zone ordinances to be presented to the City Council, and authorize the DCP to make additional, non-substantive text edits to the plan policy documents and land use designation maps to correct typographical errors, and make other technical corrections / modifications to the zoning ordinances as necessary.
5. ADOPT the Resolution adopting General Plan Elements in the document dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit C – Resolution Adopting General Plan Elements" inclusive of the modifications in the document dated October 16, 2026, and titled "Director of Planning Technical Memo", to do the following:
a. Adopt the revised San Pedro Community Plan Policy document dated June 11, 2026, and identified as, "Exhibit C1 - Community Policy Document (Plan Text)".
b. Adopt the General Plan Land Use Map for the San Pedro Community Plan, inclusive of Symbols, Footnotes, and Corresponding Zones and Land Use Nomenclature document dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit C3 - Proposed General Plan Land Use Map," and the General Plan Land Use Change Map and Matrix document dated June 11, 2026, and identified as, "Exhibit C4 - General Plan Land Use Map and Matrix".
c. Amend the Mobility Plan 2035 to reclassify a selected Street Designation, as detailed in the document dated June 11, 2026, and identified as, "Exhibit C6 - Mobility Plan 2035 Amendments”.
d. Amend the General Plan Framework Amendments, as detailed in the document dated June 11, 2026, and identified as, "Exhibit C5 General Plan Framework Amendments."
6. APPROVE the proposed ordinance to amend the Zoning Map, in the document dated June 11, 2026 and identified as Exhibit D1 - “Zone Change Map and Matrix”, along with the modifications outlined in the document dated October 16, 2026, and titled "Director of Planning Technical Memo".
7. REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present the following ordinances for City Council adoption:
a. The proposed Chapter 1A Zoning Code ordinance dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit E1 - Amendments to the New Zoning Code", along with the modifications outlined in the document dated October 16, 2026, and titled "Director of Planning Technical Memo".
b. The proposed San Pedro Zoning Code Update Hillside Area Map, San Pedro and Citywide dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D2 - Hillside Area Map, San Pedro and Citywide".
c. The proposed San Pedro Zoning Code Update Targeted Planting Map dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D3 - Targeted Planting Map".
d. The proposed San Pedro Zoning Code Update Freeway Adjacency Map dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D4 - Freeway Adjacency Map".
e. The proposed San Pedro Zoning Code Update Alcohol Permission Area Map, San Pedro and Citywide dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D5 - Alcohol Permission Area Map, San Pedro and Citywide".
f. The proposed San Pedro Zoning Code Update Repeal of the San Pedro Community Plan Implementation Overlay District dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D6 - Repeal of the San Pedro Community Plan Implementation Overlay District".
g. The proposed San Pedro Zoning Code Update San Pedro Specific Plan Text Document Technical Amendments dated June 11, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D7 - San Pedro Specific Plan Text Document Technical Amendments".
h. The proposed Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program map, San Pedro and Citywide, in the document dated October 16, 2026, and identified as "Exhibit D8 - Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map".
8. AUTHORIZE the DCP within a year of the effective dates of the ordinances and resolutions to update the ordinances and resolutions as follows:
a. As deemed necessary by the Director of Planning, DCP may prepare technical corrections to the ordinances and resolutions adopted through Council file No. 26-1355 in order to correct citations and typographical errors that do not result in substantive changes to the policies adopted by the City Council in their approval of the final ordinances and resolutions, in consultation with the City Attorney. Such technical corrections may include:
i. Corrections to typographical errors and citations.
ii. Stylistic and formatting consistency edits.
iii. Corrections to ensure consistency between provisions.
iv. Corrections to clarify the implementation of a provision.
v. Updates to illustrations or graphics to align with the text of the ordinance or resolution.
vi. Corrections to map errors.
b. The DCP shall transmit any needed corrections to the City Council for final approval by Ordinance. The Ordinance does not need to be transmitted to the LACPC.
9. INSTRUCT the Director of Planning to make updates to the General Plan Land Use Map correspondence table and to the Zoning Ordinance Map to reflect nomenclature changes and minor technical corrections as described in the document dated October 16, 2026, and titled "Director of Planning Technical Memo."
10. INSTRUCT the Director of City Planning to adopt the "Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program Map" of the New Zoning Code pursuant to Section 1.5.1.B.1 (Adoption and Maintenance of Zoning Code Maps) of Chapter 1A of LAMC identified as "Director of Planning Technical Memo".
11. INSTRUCT the DCP to transmit the Ordinances, with the modifications as described in the document dated October 16, 2026, and titled "Director of Planning Technical Memo", back to Council to be considered for adoption when the Ordinances are considered at Council. The San Pedro Community Plan Area (CPA) is located adjacent to the Port of Los Angeles, the Wilmington-Harbor City Community Plan Area, the Pacific Ocean, and the City of Rancho Palos Verdes. It is generally bounded by: Taper Avenue on the north; John S. Gibson Boulevard, Harbor Boulevard, the West Channel of the Port of Los Angeles, and Cabrillo Beach on the east; the Pacific Ocean on the south; and the western border of Los Angeles with the City of Rancho Palos Verdes.
Applicant: City of Los Angeles Case No. CPC-2025-7122-GPA-ZC-CPIO-SP-CA
Environmental No. ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD4
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LACPC reports that there is no General Fund impact as administrative costs are recovered through fees.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 6, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 4, 2026
summary: Council action to adopt the San Pedro Community Plan update, which rezones every parcel in the community to the city's new zoning code and repeals the existing implementation overlay district.
